sq.q: How does choosing the right programming paradigm affect your mini-project? ​
answer: The paradigm shapes code structure and design decisions. OOP encourages modularity and reusability; event-driven models work well with GUI-based apps; procedural paradigms are straightforward for linear workflows

The system should allow students to submit feedback through a form, store it in memory or file, and generate a report. You also need to submit a dissertation documenting your work.Outline the design, implementation, and documentation plan for the above project.
